company.name: Bandhan Ventures Pvt. Ltd.
company.summary: Fictional Indian e-commerce SaaS Series B with three SEA-flavored edge cases: (1) Series A is participating-with-cap (3x), (2) Series Seed carries full-ratchet anti-dilution from a distressed 2022 bridge, (3) all preferred classes are CCPS (Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares) per Indian Companies Act 2013 and FEMA preference for cross-border equity. Founders hold dual-class voting common (5x voting, identical economic rights — modeled as one economic class). Side letters introduce a super-pro-rata investor right that contradicts a clean reading of the cap table.

share_classes.name: Founders Common (Class A)
share_classes.voting_differential: 5x — Class A founders' shares carry 5 votes per share; identical economic rights to ordinary common. Modeled as one economic class for waterfall (per VIMA / Cyril Amarchand commentary on Indian dual-class structures).

anti_dilution._planted_note: G03-A: rare clause; trace to 2022 distressed bridge negotiation. Affects conversion ratio if a future down-round occurs at lower price-per-share. Does not affect waterfall at this valuation date because no down-round has occurred.

participation._planted_note: G03-B: participating-with-cap is the central edge-case mechanic for this fixture. Above the cap, Series A elects pure conversion to common (forgoing LP+participation). This produces additional breakpoints in the waterfall.

side_letters.title: Founders' Class A — Dual-Class Voting
side_letters.summary: Founders hold 4,000,000 shares of Class A Common with 5x voting rights and identical economic rights to ordinary common. Per VIMA / Cyril Amarchand commentary on Indian dual-class structures, this is modeled as a single economic class for waterfall purposes.

side_letters.title: Super pro-rata side letter — Series B strategic investor
side_letters.summary: A strategic Series B investor holding ₹400M of the ₹875M Series B round has been granted a 1.5x super pro-rata right in the next preferred financing. This affects future-round dilution modeling but does not affect the present-date waterfall.
side_letters._planted_note: G03-C: super-pro-rata is a forward-looking right; tool flags it for the analyst to capture in the audit memo's 'subsequent events' section.

side_letters.title: Series Seed full-ratchet provenance memo
side_letters.summary: Full-ratchet anti-dilution on Series Seed traces to a 2022 distressed bridge round when the company was 6 months from running out of capital and the bridge investor demanded down-round protection. The clause has not yet been triggered (no down-round has occurred). Documented for audit memo footnote.

_fixture_design_notes.purpose: SEA edge case demonstrating participating-with-cap, full-ratchet anti-dilution (documented but not triggered), CCPS instrument type, and dual-class voting common.
_fixture_design_notes.math_complexity: Highest of three fixtures. Eight breakpoints due to participating-with-cap interactions. Verifier test exists in tests/test_fixture_03_participating.py.
